fields.label: Subnet
fields.description: Inside 100.64.0.0/10. The default holds 4,094 members. Fixed once servers or devices exist.

fields.label: Hub Endpoint
fields.description: Public UDP endpoint, such as 203.0.113.10:51820 or [2001:db8::10]:51820.

fields.label: Stale After (Minutes)
fields.description: A server that has not reported for this long is Stale, and managers are notified.

fields.label: Access Control
fields.description: When on, engineer devices reach only the servers granted in VPN Access. Servers always reach each other.

fields.label: VPN-Only Desk
fields.description: Staff use this site only over the VPN, at the hub's VPN address. Host users and an engineer's first device are exempt. Turn on only after Desk opens over the VPN.

fields.label: Onboarding Window (Minutes)
fields.description: An engineer may use the site from outside the VPN until their first device is this old, to copy its configuration.
